channel.title: Dishant Modh - Articles
channel.description: PostgreSQL, AWS and database reliability articles by Dishant Modh.

item.title: How I Cut PostgreSQL p95 Latency from 1.8s to 0.9s
item.description: A practical playbook for PostgreSQL query tuning: pg_stat_statements, EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS), index redesign, autovacuum tuning and lock analysis.

item.title: Zero-Downtime Database Migrations: On-Prem to AWS with DMS and pglogical
item.description: A cutover-first guide to migrating production PostgreSQL and MySQL to AWS with AWS DMS and pglogical: replication, validation, sequences, rollback and runbook.

item.title: DR Readiness for Aurora Global Database: From Architecture to Quarterly Drills
item.description: How to make Aurora Global Database disaster recovery real: RPO and RTO targets, switchover vs failover, replication lag monitoring, runbooks and automated drills.

item.title: MongoDB Aggregation Tuning in Production (and Fixing Cassandra Hotspots)
item.description: How to speed up slow MongoDB aggregation pipelines: explain(), stage ordering, ESR indexes, $lookup cost, plus a note on Cassandra partition key hotspots.

item.title: Datadog + Grafana Alerting That Actually Reduces MTTR
item.description: Design database alerting that shortens incidents: symptom-based alerts, SLO burn rates, anomaly monitors, runbook links and the dashboards on-call engineers need.

item.title: PostgreSQL On-Call Playbook for P1/P0 Incidents
item.description: A calm first-15-minutes playbook for PostgreSQL incidents: triage queries for connections, locks, replication, disk and wraparound, plus communication and post-mortems.

item.title: PgBouncer Explained: Connection Pooling Modes, Sizing and Pitfalls
item.description: When and how to use PgBouncer with PostgreSQL: session vs transaction pooling, sizing the pool, prepared statements, monitoring and common pitfalls.

item.title: Terraform for RDS: Reusable Module Patterns and Drift Detection
item.description: How to build a safe, reusable Terraform module for Amazon RDS: sane defaults, deletion protection, secrets, parameter groups, testing and scheduled drift detection.

item.title: Aurora PostgreSQL vs RDS PostgreSQL: A Practical Decision Guide
item.description: Compare Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL and RDS for PostgreSQL on architecture, failover, replicas, cost model and compatibility, with a checklist for choosing.

item.title: PostgreSQL Backups and Point-in-Time Recovery: Test Your Restores
item.description: A practical guide to PostgreSQL backups: base backups, WAL archiving, point-in-time recovery steps, RDS PITR and how to prove your restores work.

item.title: AWS Database Cost Optimization: A Right-Sizing Framework That Works
item.description: A step-by-step framework to cut AWS database and compute costs safely: find idle resources, right-size with percentiles, pick storage and pricing, and automate.

item.title: Patroni High Availability for PostgreSQL: Architecture, Config and Failover Testing
item.description: How Patroni and etcd deliver automatic PostgreSQL failover: architecture, a minimal configuration, the key timing parameters, split-brain safety and how to test failover.

item.title: PostgreSQL Index Types Explained: B-tree, GIN, GiST, BRIN and When to Use Each
item.description: Choose the right PostgreSQL index: B-tree, Hash, GIN, GiST, SP-GiST and BRIN compared, plus partial, expression, covering and multicolumn indexes with examples.
